facts.value: Fulfil your potential as an international manager of the future with UL’s one-year, full-time Master of Science in International Management.
An MSc in International Management helps you stand out in a competitive global job market by demonstrating advanced strategic and analytical capabilities.
Deep understanding of how businesses operate across borders, cultures, and regulatory systems.
Strengthened leadership, negotiation, and communication skills essential for success in international roles.
Gained confidence and expertise to make informed, ethical decisions that shape the future of global business.
Unique blend of academic and practical learning providing an in-depth understanding of the successful management of the global enterprise.
Development of an international, cross-cultural and global mindset.
Delivered by an internationally experienced teaching team.
State-of-the-art teaching facilities at the Kemmy Business School.
Offers a dual degree opportunity with one of seven business schools in France.
